judgment.note: PRODUCT-QUARANTINE CHECK RUN EXPLICITLY, AND IT DOES NOT FIRE. Pass 2a called this 'An open rectangular electrical cutout is high on the partition wall' and 2d resolved that bullet to visible_electrical_risks, whose trade_bucket is electrical - the one product_quarantined trade - so this row looked like a rule-2 case. PHOTO OPENED: redfin_11000447/photo_008.jpg (same open as row g10), to answer 'does the cutout expose electrical components, or is it a plain rough-edged wall opening?'. It is a small rectangular rough-edged opening high on the partition above the vanity showing brown backing material, with NO conductors, no device box, no cover-plate remnant and no scorch marks. visible_electrical_risks' claim ('electrical components | exposed wiring, scorch marks, or unsafe components') is therefore not what is visible; the word 'electrical' came from a 2a guess about the opening's purpose, not from anything in the image. The nearest covering concept is a rough-edged hole in a wall, and damaged_drywall_or_cracks claims exactly that ('drywall | cracks, holes, or impact damage'), scene-eligible in bathroom. FLAGGED PLAINLY: if the lead reads triage rule 2 as driven by the frozen 2d resolution's trade metadata rather than by the nearest covering concept, this row flips to product_quarantined - I read it as the latter, both because the rule says 'nearest covering concept' and because LEAD_VERIFIED_FACTS section 6 makes billability the precondition and warns against inflating the apparent cost of the electrical quarantine with rows that are not really electrical.

judgment.not_promoted_reason: An existing item covers the subject, trade, scope and work item, so there is no gap to promote; and the row is a single human/gold unit from a single property, which could not meet the evidence bar in any case.
judgment.note: Not an electrical row despite the electrical-sounding neighbours on this photo. I opened redfin_11000447/photo_008.jpg to answer one question: is the access-panel wall a finished wall (a patch-and-finish defect) or an unfinished/stripped assembly (a different item)? Answer: the green partition wall beside the vanity is finished and painted, with a large square screw-fastened panel cut into it, screw heads and gapped, crudely cut edges visible, plus a separate small rectangular cutout higher on the same wall. So the scope is DRYWALL_PATCH on a finished wall - not exposed OSB (unfinished_interior_wall_osb_exposed) and not stripped-to-studs (interior_wall_stripped_to_studs). IMPORTANT caveat on 'covered': damaged_drywall_or_cracks covers this on its RETRIEVAL surface only. Its description says 'poor repairs' and its embed_text says 'rough patches, missing sections', but its atomic_claim - the only text Terra sees - is 'drywall cracks, holes, or impact damage', and divergence_scan records promised_not_claimed = missing_incomplete for exactly this item. A correctly retrieved crude access panel could therefore be rejected at Terra on claim wording. That is a catalog_wording_or_specificity signal for whichever cluster owns damaged_drywall_or_cracks (in_worklist=true; it is implicated by CAP-014), not a new coverage gap. What actually happened on this photo: 2d routed 'Walls show patching and rough edges.' to wall_scuffs_marks_or_dents, i.e. the condition landed on a hidden degradation item rather than on the visible defect item.

derived.finding: Stone-pattern floor surface has white residue or staining and darkened grout/joint lines

judgment.note: Reviewer supports the finding: chalky whitish residue in patches, and printed joint lines darkened with dirt, especially around the toilet and the doorway. 'Printed joint lines' means this is a stone-pattern resilient/sheet floor, not real tile with real grout - which rules out the tile items on subject grounds independent of their claims. floor_dirty_or_heavily_soiled is the cover: its subject is 'floor' (material-agnostic), its embed_text names grime, tracked-in dirt, darkened grout and widespread staining, and bathroom is in its scene_groups. Alternatives considered and rejected as the primary ref: worn_or_stained_flooring (claim 'flooring wear, staining, or discoloration without structural concern') is a defensible second cover whose claim has no 'heavy' threshold, but it is scope=replace and the reviewer describes dirt and residue - an upkeep condition - not material deterioration warranting replacement; vinyl_linoleum_worn_or_stained is the right material family but its deny_any contains 'tile', which the finding's own wording risks tripping, and it likewise asserts wear on the material rather than soiling on it; tile_or_grout_damage is wrong twice over (no real grout here, and its atomic claim covers only broken/loose/missing despite an embed_text promising 'stained'). Same claim-strictness caveat as g6: the covering item's atomic claim says 'heavy visible soiling' while the reviewer describes patchy residue and darkened joints. As with g6 the residual miss is upstream: the photo's 2a bullets cover the vanity, wall scuffs, the toe-kick, wall patching, an electrical cutout and 'the flooring appears dated' (resolved to older_flooring_style) - nothing observed the residue or the darkened joints, so there was no bullet for 2d to resolve. floor_dirty_or_heavily_soiled was reachable in the frozen candidates (rank 6 and rank 3 on two observations) but never selected. No photo opened.

The actionable owner is the shortcut rule - support_any is documented as a non-gating ranking hint and 125 of 128 items author bare subject nouns into it - not this item's tokens. policy.adjudication: a unit counts as support only when adjudicated supports_claim against the cluster claim_under_test after photo and lineage review; refuted, unclear, unavailable, and missing units are context and never inflate counts.
policy.coverage_gaps: an evidence-backed missing-coverage group that meets the bar is promoted regardless of expressibility: native if a legitimate split parent exists, else migration_system_gap.
policy.evidence_bar: two_independent_human = at least two adjudicated human/gold units (same property flagged and noted); one_human_plus_independent_corroboration = one adjudicated human/gold unit plus an adjudicated gold/lead unit on a different photo and condition (same photo/condition is method corroboration); structural_exception = a single case plus a mechanically demonstrable universal catalog fact and written justification, never for a missing-coverage cluster; none => deferred_insufficient_evidence or no_change unless the outcome is refutation-backed. A reviewed refutation (a human/gold support-or-counterexample unit adjudicated refuted with photos available) never raises the bar but may ground no_change, non_catalog_action or migration_system_gap; when human/gold support units are both supported and refuted the claim must carry a conflict_note.
policy.evidence_classes: human_review (queue case with human truth) and gold_reference (gold photo finding) are human evidence; model_judge (factorized lead) is a model pointer that never satisfies the bar alone; the review session's photo/lineage adjudication is a model annotation that can refute a lead but cannot upgrade it.
policy.noise_floor: human self-consistency 80% on the v1.1 repeat arm; Terra replica disagreement 6.4%; the 2d-vs-Terra stage boundary sits inside that noise (docs/RESULT_error_attribution_20260831.md section 7).
policy.non_deferred_outcomes: native conclusions cite only adjudicated, photo-and-lineage-reviewed human/gold support and require a met bar; non-catalog, migration-system-gap and no-change conclusions cite at least one reviewed human/gold unit, support or refutation, with photos available; model-only leads, unclear, unavailable and missing rows never qualify; only deferral may rest on unavailable or unclear evidence.
policy.operational_equivalence: every cluster records mismatch_class, and the dimensions that differ whenever it is operationally_consequential; equivalence requires the same physical subject, repair, approximate scope, billability, trade/route and safety implication; a wrong subject, mechanism, severity, route or implied diagnostic obligation is consequential even under a shared broad repair label; internal catalog precision may be finer than the UI, and no item is added or split to make the UI more verbose.
policy.pooling: one semantic issue across several items is one cluster; pooling rests on shared subject + mechanism + commitment type recorded in merge_split_rationale, never on the R1/R3 stage label.
policy.priority: judge on fewer hallucinations and fewer lost real conditions; dollar effects are context only (Steven, 2026-08-21).
policy.quarantine: product-quarantined trades (from catalog metadata) are non_catalog_action / product_quarantined by rule.
policy.review_binding: each unit's adjudication is read from the pinned review row named by review_row_id (default {proposal_id}:{unit_key}, or coverage:{unit_key} for a promoted coverage unit); rows may be bound across reshaped clusters only with cluster.reshape and a per-unit transfer_note, and a reshaped cluster reads its controls from the source cluster; one reviewed row grounds exactly one cluster; adjudications are never rewritten, and packet drift after reshaping is expected because the pinned packet remains the reviewed one.
policy.review_provenance: photo/lineage review runs in a separate session against reports/catalog_audit_photo_review_packet.json and writes reports/catalog_audit_photo_review.json, pinned by sha256; diagnosis fields stay null until the results are pinned.
policy.scope_direction: catalog-first intervention (Steven, 2026-09-03): the primary candidates are catalog-owned misses of real billable conditions and consequential semantic defects; Pass 2a is frozen, so Pass-2a-owned findings are deferred with reason out_of_scope_pass_2a and hallucination cards serve only as regression controls; Pass 2d is the next optimisation target after approved catalog work, so a reachable-right-item selection failure is recorded in pass_2d_follow_ups with the catalog left unchanged.
